datasets.processing_method: Sentinel-1 RTC (gamma0, Planetary Computer) VV, averaged to the model grid, 3x3 median filter; water = VV < -18 dB. Flood (new water) = water on the post-event date AND not water on the dry-season baseline (same relative orbit 77, descending) AND JRC GSW occurrence < 20% (excludes the routinely wet river bed and chars); binary opening (1 iter). Wind-roughened open water and flooded vegetation/settlements (double bounce) are known false negatives; radar shadow on slopes is negligible on this floodplain.

datasets.attribution: Google Open Buildings v3 (CC BY 4.0)
datasets.uncertainty_notes: Machine-learning footprints from satellite imagery of mixed dates; false positives/negatives; may include buildings destroyed by the event or miss new ones. Heights are model estimates where present, otherwise unknown.

datasets.processing_method: Sentinel-2 L2A change detection on the model grid: debris/scour = valid in both scenes (SCL not cloud/shadow/no-data) AND [(post-pre NDVI < -0.15 and post NDVI < 0.45) OR (post NDVI < 0.18, bright, pre NDVI > 0.25)] AND (within 2 cells of a DEM-derived channel, D8 contributing area > 0.1 km2, OR within 150 m of a mapped OSM waterway); 8-connected components smaller than 8 cells (~0.006 km2) removed (no opening, so 1-cell-wide channels survive).
datasets.license: derived from Copernicus Sentinel data (free and open)
datasets.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data
datasets.uncertainty_notes: Derived change indicator, NOT an official damage or flood map and not field-validated. Includes any vegetation loss near rivers between the two dates (e.g. seasonal/agricultural change); misses damage under intact canopy and in built-up areas; post-event scene is weeks-months after the event.
datasets.validation_status: visual comparison with imagery; area reported

datasets.processing_method: same-day neighbouring tiles mosaicked to fill edges; cubic resample
datasets.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2024
datasets.uncertainty_notes: Display only. Clouds/no-data (black) possible at the edges.

datasets.uncertainty_notes: Scene cloud 0.0%; AOI quality from SCL: {'valid': 1.0, 'snow': 0.0, 'water': 0.0}. Post-event; acquisition is 140 days after the event.

datasets.uncertainty_notes: Volunteered data of uneven completeness; current OSM state (may include post-event edits; does not mark damage). Attributes like surface/condition mostly absent and are NOT inferred.
